details:
If you make world, you must always put somewhere VRCWorld. This is your main spawnpoint.
If your world is ready to upload, you will notice something is annoying. The VRCCam for picture is ALWAYS 180 degrees looking to other side!
Why is VRCCam always opposite, every time you start upload and want update the picture?
This is so stupid. Make the VRCCam rotation is SAME as VRCWorld.

The reason is simple. Where you put down VRCWorld, you adjust it too for correct looking in the world (you can rotate it too). It should more logical the VRCCam should do it exact same like VRCWorld rotation, means you look in same direction as VRCWorld.

But i have never seen this. The VRCCam is looking always in other direciton, 180 degrees. I must ALWAYS fix the VRCCam rotation and that is totally stupid and unneeded. No matter if i click to make world and want upload it, and update image too, it's always wrong in first place.

Fix this in the SDK please so it's in same looking direction like VRCWorld point. It's so easy fix and makes things also much better for most users, even new world builders. Then it's just small movement to correct it in like height. Fast and easy.

But now, i still don't get it at all why VRCCam is always 180 degrees off, looking to "back"? Who made this idea, and this problem exists actually for months, also in 2018 build. Same old problem with weird VRCCam setup.
title: Wrong VRCCam rotation when put VRCWorld down.
